systems.owner: the land conservation service, with the Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier (ANDF) and its communal offices
systems.tiers: organised at national and communal scale; a parcel's extract is deposited at ANDF's central administration and in each mairie; online read-only access for private users

note: The land code, a law: it defines the cadastre as a unitary computerised archive kept by the conservation service and ANDF's deconcentrated communal offices (Articles 34 to 49) and gives mayors paper registers of customary rights (Articles 629 to 632); it states nothing on any commune office's connection or equipment.
